notes.title: Bugfix
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A) All achievement bugs are fixed (those about unlocking a specific number of characters).
Gold spending is cumulative and will trigger the related achievements.
Also DLC now unlocks all money and character related achievements immediately.

B) Although DLC is installed on most computers without problem, some people reported a DLC issue.
They checked the DLC install box, but DLC stayed in "not installed" status.

Below are the 2 possible ways you can solve the issue.

1. Right click on the title of the game in your library in steam. Go to "view downloadable content" then go to local files tab click on "verify integrity of game cache".

2. Right click on the title of the game in your library in steam. Go to "view downloadable content”, and check mark install option.

If this two things doesn't work, then in that case there might not be enough space in the PC.

If you updated steam and if you have connection and waited long enough for DLC to install, but if you still have the problem, please contact Steam.

Have a nice day!
